title: cerastium vulgatum var. tianschanicum
intro: Cerastium vulgatum var. tianschanicum, commonly known as the Chinese cranesbill, is a plant species in the carnation family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Cerastium vulgatum var. tianschanicum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as expectorant, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory properties.
